Recipes for working on the module itself: building it from its repository, testing a change, and updating these pages. Using the module needs none of this: it installs from the PowerShell Gallery, as [Getting Started](Getting-Started.md) shows.

- [Build from source](building-from-source/) - what the build needs, the module folder it writes, the other platforms, and the import.
- [Run the tests](how-to-run-the-tests/) - lint, unit tests and Pester in both hosts, on another adapter or platform, and a test of your own.
- [Update the docs](how-to-update-the-docs/) - the reference, the examples' output, the pictures, and the site with its checks.
